clips.title: The story
paras: In Stonetalon, jagged metal remains lodged deep inside corrupted treants. The Venture Company’s retreating munitions left fragments in the forest’s protectors, now sought for study.

When the Venture Company was driven from Stonetalon’s groves, its goblins used reckless munitions to cover their escape. Explosive shrapnel tore into the valley’s defending treants, lodging deep within their bark and core. The ancient guardians slowly succumbed to corruption. Their wood blackened, and their fury turned against anyone entering the vale. Kaela Shadowspear seeks the rusted fragments so Gaxim Rustfizzle, a gnome, can study how the weapons brought on the treants’ corruption.
